column1: # comment: "Observation stack alignments: SOSA/SSN, PROV-O, CIDOC-CRM E13. The gmeow:vantage property has no direct SOSA counterpart (sosa:madeBySensor is device-centric, not standpoint-centric); the alignment is closeMatch with a note. math:Quantity and math:quantityValue are the sole quantity/value authorities; their SOSA, OM, IVOA, LOINC, and QUDT grounding correspondences are authored by the math slice in mappings/quantity-bridges.ttl, while this catalog owns observation qualifiers and domain roles. Added: StandpointClaim \u2192 sosa:Observation; Agent \u2192 sosa:Sensor (the observer/sensor/perceiver is a standpoint). Added (observation-spine bridge): IdentityFacet, NameUsage, RightsStatement, and KinRelationship \u2192 sosa:Observation (universal claim construct); facetSubject / facetVantage \u2192 sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest / sosa:madeBySensor. Added (stream-to-trajectory design): Stream \u2192 sosa:ObservationCollection; streamSample \u2192 sosa:hasMember; Agent \u2192 sosa:Platform; streamSensor \u2192 sosa:madeBySensor; streamInterval \u2192 sosa:phenomenonTime; Observation \u2192 sosa:Sampling. Added (spatial-measurement design): SpatialMeasurement and CoordinateObservation \u2192 sosa:Observation, iso19156:OM_Observation / OM_GeometryObservation, crmarc:S4_Observation; coordinateResult / geometryResult \u2192 sosa:hasResult. Added (sensory slice): Sensor \u2192 sosa:Sensor (precise alignment, superseding Agent broadMatch); SensorPlatform \u2192 sosa:Platform (precise alignment, superseding Agent relatedMatch); ObservableProperty \u2192 sosa:ObservableProperty; SensoryQuantity \u2192 sosa:Result; sensoryProperty \u2192 sosa:observedProperty; platformLocation \u2192 geo:location; Sensor \u2192 obi:device; observationMethod \u2192 oboe:Protocol / obi:assay; ObservableProperty \u2192 oboe:Characteristic / pato:quality; SensoryObservation \u2192 qb:Observation; unit \u2192 om:hasUnit."

column6: comment

An agent acting as vantage/observer/perceiver IS a standpoint (Principle 9). sosa:Sensor is device-centric and narrower; the alignment bridges the SOSA sensor concept to the broader GMEOW agent-as-standpoint doctrine.
An agent hosting sensors can act as a platform (broader than the sosa:Sensor alignment in eqObs018).
CRMarchaeo S4 Observation covers stratigraphic and spatial observations in archaeological context.
ISO 19156 O&M GeometryObservation is the closest O&M class for coordinate/geometry assignment.
SOSA does not distinguish coordinate observation types; CoordinateObservation is a kind of Observation.
SOSA does not distinguish observation types; an identity claim (gender, expression, orientation) is a kind of observation in the universal stack.
SOSA does not distinguish observation types; a kinship claim is a kind of observation in the universal stack.
A Measurement is a kind of Observation; SOSA does not distinguish them.
SOSA does not distinguish observation types; a naming claim is a kind of observation in the universal stack.
OBOE Characteristic is the property being measured; GMEOW ObservableProperty is a value vocabulary (individuals).
PATO quality (PATO:0000001) is the broadest quality class; GMEOW ObservableProperty is a value vocabulary of specific observable properties.
A property that can be observed or measured by a sensor. GMEOW models it as a gufo:QualityValue vocabulary (individuals); SOSA as a class.
LOINC Component identifies what is being measured (glucose, WBC, etc.).
A sampling act is a kind of observation; GMEOW models it through observationTypeSampling.

CIDOC-CRM E13 Attribute Assignment is the closest CRM class for an observation: it is both the activity of assigning an attribute and, in GMEOW terms, the observation that results from such an activity. The event perspective is aligned to gmeow:ObservationalActivity in the events mapping set.
CRMarchaeo S4 Observation is the closest CRM class for a stratigraphic or physical-layer observation.
OBOE Observation is the core observation construct in the Extensible Observation Ontology; GMEOW Observation unifies it with measurement, standpoint claim, and identity claim.
An Observation is a relator (gufo), but as a named individual it is also a prov:Entity that can be attributed, derived, and versioned.
LOINC Method describes how a laboratory test was performed; close match to GMEOW ObservationMethod in clinical contexts.

OBI investigation (OBI:0000011) is a planned process with the objective to produce information about some evaluant — the closest OBI class for a structured observational activity such as a clinical trial or survey.

CRMarchaeo A1 Excavation Process Unit is the closest class for an observational activity whose event type is excavation. Related match because A1 is specifically about destructive excavation, not any observational activity.
IPTC NewsMessage is the report container; GMEOW ObservationalActivity is broader than journalism (science, archaeology, clinical trials, etc.).

An ObservationalActivity that produces aggregate statistical data (e.g. a census) projects to an RDF Data Cube DataSet. Related match because the activity and the dataset are distinct: one generates the other.
CRMarchaeo A2 Stratigraphic Volume Unit is the physical layer being observed in an archaeological context.
SNOMED CT Patient is the subject of a clinical observation. Related match because observedFeature is more general (any entity, not only patients).
SOSA does not distinguish observation types; a rights claim is a kind of observation in the universal stack.
OBI device (OBI:0000968) is a material entity that is designed to perform a function. A GMEOW Sensor is an Agent (observer) that may be realised by a device.
Precise alignment: a GMEOW Sensor is a more specific kind of Agent that acts as vantage in a SensoryObservation. Supersedes the broader Agent → sosa:Sensor broadMatch (eqObs018).
IVOA ObsCore facility identifies the telescope or observatory that produced the observation.
IVOA ObsCore instrument identifies the instrument aboard the facility. Two relatedMatch rows because GMEOW Sensor unifies facility and instrument.
Precise alignment: a GMEOW SensorPlatform hosts sensors and is situated at a place. Supersedes the broader Agent → sosa:Platform relatedMatch (eqObs031).
IVOA ObsCore ObsDataset is the closest class for an astronomical observation dataset.
QB Observation is contextual — a SensoryObservation becomes a QB Observation when it is part of a qb:DataSet / qb:Slice. The alignment is closeMatch with context note.
LOINC LabTest is the closest LOINC class for a laboratory test observation. Related match because GMEOW SensoryObservation covers any sensory/perceptual observation, not only lab tests.
SNOMED CT ClinicalFinding is an observation interpreted as a diagnosis or finding.
sosa:Result is broader (any result); gmeow:SensoryQuantity is specifically a sensory-produced scalar numeric and specializes the sole math:Quantity authority.
ISO 19156 O&M is the conceptual geographic standard that inspired SOSA/SSN. SpatialMeasurement aligns to the generic OM_Observation.
SOSA does not distinguish spatial measurement types; SpatialMeasurement is a kind of Observation.
SOSA does not distinguish observation types; a standpoint claim is a kind of observation, and the standpoint-indexed statement realises sosa:Observation.
BBC NewsEvent is a reported real-world event; GMEOW StandpointClaim generalises this to any standpoint-indexed claim, not only news.

Open Annotation Annotation is the closest W3C construct for a standpoint-indexed claim with body (the claim) and target (the observed feature). The projection layer provides the directional mapping to oa:hasBody / oa:hasTarget.
SOSA has no first-class Stream; ObservationCollection is the closest grouping construct.
the modality result of a standpoint claim is the SOSA result of the observation (StandpointTenure observation design)
coordinateResult is the GeoCoordinates-specific subproperty of observationResult; aligns to SOSA's generic hasResult.
facetSubject is the observedFeature of an identity claim; aligns to SOSA's feature of interest.
facetVantage is the asserting agent of an identity claim; aligns to SOSA's sensor (device-centric, broader via broadMatch on Agent).
geometryResult is the Geometry-specific subproperty of observationResult; aligns to SOSA's generic hasResult.
IVOA ObsCore coordsys carries coordinate system metadata for celestial reference frames. Related match because GMEOW hasReferenceFrame is more general (spatial, temporal, and celestial frames).
OBI assay (OBI:0000070) is a planned process with the objective to produce information about some evaluant. Aligns to the procedure/method of an observation.
The procedure or protocol used to make an observation.
Inverse direction: prov:wasGeneratedBy links Entity to Activity; gmeow:observationResult links Observation to its result Entity. Semantic alignment, not structural identity.
OBOE Entity is broader (any entity); GMEOW observedFeature is the specific entity whose property is being observed.
SOSA core has no direct platform-location property; bridge via GeoSPARQL geo:location by reference.
The observable property that a sensory observation measures.
Stream interval vs per-observation phenomenon time.
Stream sample is a member of the observation collection.
Per-stream vs per-observation sensor attribution.

OM models om:hasUnit as the property relating a measure to its om:Unit; gmeow:unit is the parallel property edge (a quantity to its unit IRI), so the alignment stays property-to-property. GMEOW unit points to QUDT by default, with OM as an alternative by reference.
crm:P14 is event-centric; gmeow:vantage is relator-centric. Semantic alignment on 'who performed it'.
prov:wasAttributedTo is a property, gmeow:vantage is a property; the alignment is on the semantic axis (who is responsible), not structural identity.
SOSA is device-centric; gmeow:vantage covers human standpoints, organizations, and sensors alike. CloseMatch with a note.
IPTC Assertor is the person or organisation making the claim; GMEOW vantage is broader (human, machine, organisational, or sensor standpoint).

LOINC Quantity is a clinical numeric-result kind with a unit; math:Quantity is domain-independent and carries an explicit dimension. The clinical commitment is a validation-only bridge view rather than mathematical identity.

IVOA ObsCore observable names the measured physical-quantity field of an astronomical dataset, while math:Quantity is the domain-independent dimensioned value object. The role/context shift makes this a validation-only bridge view.

OM 1.8 Measure is the older value-and-unit carrier corresponding to the dimensioned math:Quantity surface; the local quantity additionally carries an explicit math:Dimension and observation qualifiers remain external to this correspondence.
A math:Quantity can fill the SOSA result role, but sosa:Result is role-defined and includes non-quantitative results. This is a validation-only commitment-shifting bridge, not a type equivalence.
